trial_title: Safety and Efficacy Trial of Testosterone Undecanoate
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to determine if oral testosterone undecanoate is effective and safe in the treatment of low testosterone in men.

eligibility_table.criterion: Serum testosterone of less than or equal to 300 ng/dL (the mean of two samples collected 1 hour apart in the morning between 6:00 and 10:00 AM)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's serum testosterone level is 65 ng/dL, which is less than 300 ng/dL.

eligibility_table.justification: No significant intercurrent diseases are reported, but further medical history is needed to confirm.
